aboutCourse.heading: About the Course
aboutCourse.description: A Carrier to Career is a spoken English coaching program specifically designed for Hindi-medium students who want to speak English confidently. Our structured curriculum covers everyday conversations, interview preparation, grammar fundamentals, and public speaking skills. Classes are conducted live online, making quality English education accessible from anywhere in Chhattisgarh.

aboutTeacher.heading: Meet Your Teacher
aboutTeacher.name: Prakriti Keshri
aboutTeacher.bio: Prakriti Keshri holds an M.A. in English as a Gold Medalist and is CG SET qualified. She brings two distinct strengths: 7 years as an Assistant Professor of English, and 5 years as a spoken-English academy trainer. She founded 'A Carrier to Career' to help Hindi-medium learners truly understand English — not just translate it — and speak with real confidence. Her method focuses on practical, real-life communication, daily speaking practice, and the confidence that opens career opportunities.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our spoken English courses

questions.a: This course is designed for Hindi-medium students, working professionals, and anyone from Chhattisgarh and nearby areas who wants to learn spoken English. No prior English knowledge is required.
All classes are conducted live online via video call. You just need a smartphone and internet connection. Classes are interactive with practice sessions.
We offer affordable fees for all our courses. Please contact us via WhatsApp or call for the latest fee details.
Yes, all students receive a certificate of completion after finishing their course.

questions.q: Can I join from any city?
questions.a: Yes! Since classes are online, you can join from Ambikapur, Raipur, Bilaspur, Korba, or any city in India.

questions.q: What if I miss a class?
questions.a: Recorded sessions are available for students who miss a live class. You can watch and catch up at your own pace.

questions.q: Is Prakriti Ma'am a qualified teacher?
questions.a: Yes, Prakriti Ma'am is SET-qualified and currently works as faculty at a government college in Ambikapur, Chhattisgarh.
Simply click the WhatsApp button or call us at 7247400000. We'll guide you through the enrollment process.
